local index=1;local timer=0;local age=0;local arrived=false
local best=math.huge;local stuck=0
local function distance(a,b) local v=a-b;return math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y) end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;age=age+dt;if timer<.1 then return end
 local elapsed=timer;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during genuine wine approach')
 if core.isWorldPaused() or age<3 then return end
 local destination=waypoints[index]
 while index<#waypoints and distance(destination,self.position)<50 do
  index=index+1;destination=waypoints[index];best=math.huge;stuck=0;print('WineRoute waypoint='..index)
 end
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6752a))
 if arrived or (index==#waypoints and distance(destination,self.position)<90 and target and target:isValid()) then
  arrived=true;print('WineRoute aim x=0 y=0');print('WineRoute input=turn')
  assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original wine missing at arrival')
  print('WineRoute arrived original=06752a pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  local aim=target:getBoundingBox().center;local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
  local yaw=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z);local pitch=-math.atan2(v.y,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z))
  if math.abs(yaw)<.025 and math.abs(pitch)<.025 then print('WineRoute facing destination') end
  print(string.format('WineRoute look x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
  return
 end
 local remaining=distance(destination,self.position)
 if remaining<best-4 then best=remaining;stuck=0 elseif self.controls.movement>0 then stuck=stuck+elapsed else stuck=0 end
 if stuck>5 and index<#waypoints then
  print('WineRoute replanning past blocked intermediate waypoint='..index)
  index=index+1;best=math.huge;stuck=0;return
 end
 assert(stuck<20,'Original coastal walking blocked despite ordinary jumps')
 local eye=camera.getPosition();local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(util.vector3(destination.x,destination.y,eye.z));local angle=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
 print(string.format('WineRoute aim x=%d y=%d point=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5))),index,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,distance(destination,self.position)))
 if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('WineRoute facing') end
 print('WineRoute input='..(math.abs(angle)>.2 and 'turn' or (stuck>2 and 'jump' or 'continue')))
end}}}}
